articles.title: Braves hit three homers to beat Phillies in wild card clincher
articles.description: The Braves won a postseason series for the first time since winning the 2021 World Series.

articles.title: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo returning for 11th season with franchise
articles.description: The manager signed a two-year deal that keeps him under contract in the desert through the 2028 season.

articles.title: MLB won’t consider game at Grand Teton National Park, says was only conducting initial due diligence
articles.description: The baseball commissioner said MLB was doing its "due diligence on many potential sites" but that the national park will no longer be under consideration.

articles.title: Following loss, Willson Contreras critical of Red Sox’ reliance on data and analytics
articles.description: Boston's best hitter in 2026 suggested both specific areas in which the Sox needed to improve, but also macro-level adjustments.

articles.title: When the Red Sox reached the postseason, they exhaled and expired in two lackluster Wild Card games against the Yankees
articles.description: After fighting their way into contention, the Red Sox lost that fight, going 14-16 over the remaining 30 regular-season games.

articles.title: ‘I’m hoping they can put it back to normal’: Caleb Durbin, Mickey Gasper, Willson Contreras among Red Sox needing to heal
articles.description: Among the reasons Durbin played through his injury: He wasn’t alone.

articles.title: Sonny Gray says there’s ‘a lot of baseball left in me,’ but is undecided about what’s next
articles.description: The righthander had a solid season for the Red Sox, but was unhappy with being lifted in the fifth inning of Game 2 on Wednesday.

articles.title: Problems were myriad, but early hooks by new manager Chad Tracy were among major Red Sox missteps
articles.description: Tracy — such a feel-good story across this comeback season — turned into a pumpkin just in time for the calendar to flip to October.

articles.title: The end of this Red Sox season feels just like last year. Maybe worse.
articles.description: The Red Sox at least won a game against the Yankees in their Wild Card defeat in 2025. This year, they barely put up a fight.

articles.title: Nothing went well for the Red Sox in Game 2, and their season ended in disappointing fashion
articles.description: Chad Tracy pulled starter Sonny Gray after 4⅔ innings, and for a second straight night the bullpen let the Red Sox manager down. The Rays await the Yankees in the ALDS.

articles.title: Sonny Gray unable to keep Red Sox season alive in season-ending loss to Yankees in Game 2 of AL Wild Card Series
articles.description: Gray, 36, wound up giving up two runs on six hits in 4⅔ innings in a 9-2 setback.

articles.title: From cold bats to feeble chirps, this brief Red Sox playoff run was downright embarrassing
articles.description: The ’26 Sox were a gift. Chad Tracy’s upstarts saved New England’s summer the way Scotland saved our World Cup, but their bad side re-emerged in September and carried into the playoffs.

articles.title: Roman Anthony ‘sick’ and ‘confused’ after Red Sox forced to remove him from roster because of hand injury
articles.description: Anthony, who exited Game 1 of the AL Wild Card Series against the Yankees, learned Wednesday that the right hand ligament he partially tore in May remains damaged.

articles.title: Red Sox’ roller coaster season is over after another blowout loss to the Yankees. Here’s how it happened.
articles.description: A disastrous sixth inning turned a tight contest into a blowout.

articles.title: Curtis Mead’s strange Red Sox introduction continues with postseason activation as an injury replacement
articles.description: Mead suffered a broken left wrist July 27 when he was hit by a pitch in his second at-bat for the Red Sox. He arrived in a trade while enjoying a breakout season with the Nationals.

articles.title: Chase Meidroth and Kyle Teel help White Sox sweep Astros, win first playoff series since 2005
articles.description: Meidroth had a three-run home run, and Teel had two hits and an RBI as the White Sox advanced to the AL Division Series.
